Proposed recurrence contract for human review

Objective: Review the shared intake queue each weekday at 09:00.
Owner: Support lead.
Input condition: Use queue records updated by 08:55.

Authorized action: Label records whose supplied category is Billing or Access.
Exclusions: Do not edit record text or contact submitters.

Evidence: Append each processed record ID, applied label, and review timestamp to the audit log.

Escalation: Send records with conflicting categories to the Support lead for a category decision; do not apply an uncertain label.

Run limits: Process at most 20 records per run.

Skip condition: Skip the run when the queue export is unavailable.

Termination: Stop recurrence after 2026-12-31.

Status: Proposed for human review only; do not schedule or execute.

fingerprint_scope: SHA-256 of Python json.dumps(baseline_cases, sort_keys=True), UTF-8; input-only comparator identity, not package source. Current source and both arm jobs are bound in quality-behavior.json.
